verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents cases having an assignee, review and approval steps (peer approvers, submitting for approval to selected reviewers), and configurable workflows that mirror an organization's policies. That covers routing through review stages. Escalation stages and the operations-lead act of assigning cases are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how leads assign or reassign cases, documented escalation stages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can assign cases and route them through analyst review and escalation stages

citations.quote: You must be the assignee of the case in order to add an approver, and the workflow must be configured to allow for peer approvals.
We can easily configure your Hummingbird account with workflows that mirror your policies.
you could @-mention your selected reviewers in the Comments section and let them know... they'll receive a notification in-app and by email.
It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
